description: Anti-sycophancy CANDIDATE that did NOT earn the name. SAE feature 1848 was selected by contrast-driven search over the smoke_v0 dictionary: it shows a real correlational activation difference between independent-criticism and sycophantic-agreement continuations on the training split (standardised effect -0.463). Steering it improved the paired log-probability margin on the validation split (+0.187 mean per-token delta, win rate 0.60). That improvement DID NOT REPLICATE on the topic-disjoint held-out test: mean delta -0.0021 with a bootstrap 95% CI of [-0.154, +0.156], which spans zero. The validation gain is best explained as selection noise over 5 validation examples. Published as an honestly-named experimental candidate so the search is reproducible, NOT as a working anti-sycophancy patch.

evaluation.method: paired log-probability margin, not n-gram divergence
evaluation.margin_definition: log P(independent continuation | prompt) - log P(sycophantic continuation | prompt), per token

splits.split_policy: by TOPIC, so no topic appears in more than one split

candidate_screening.note: The firing-rate screen deliberately excludes the rare-token outlier cluster that invalidated the earlier feature-727 experiment.

strength_calibration.policy: calibrated to the feature's own activation distribution, not an arbitrary large value

controls_used.unrelated_selection: cosine similarity < 0.15 against the target AND against each other
controls_used.random_selection: scale-matched unit vectors at the same coefficient

evaluation.conclusion: NEGATIVE. The held-out mean delta is approximately zero with a confidence interval spanning zero, so no target-specific behavioural effect is demonstrated. The name 'anti-sycophancy' is NOT earned.
evaluation.statistical_caveat: 7 held-out examples on a synthetic hand-written set. This is enough to fail to demonstrate an effect; it is not enough to rule one out. A properly powered experiment would need hundreds of held-out items and a corpus matched to instruction-following behaviour.

metadata.search_method: contrast-driven SAE feature ranking with firing-rate, cosine and effect-size screening
metadata.leading_explanation_for_null: The SAE was trained on wikitext, which is a poor match for instruction-following behaviour. An instruction-formatted activation corpus is the next thing to try.
metadata.warning: Feature IDs are meaningless outside the smoke_v0 SAE.

name: experimental-independent-criticism-candidate
